nodes.label: GM Tools
nodes.description: Random encounter tables, district d10 tables, Living World System (crisis 1-10), faction action tables, Dawnborn Reaction Tracker, Moral Dilemma Scorecards, 15-min session prep, NPC reference cards, theGreatGM methods

nodes.label: Living World System
nodes.description: Crisis escalation scale 1-10; faction action tables; rumor mill; consequence echo tables; tracks city state between sessions

nodes.label: Moral Dilemma Scorecard
nodes.description: GM tracking tool for player moral choices across the campaign; used to calibrate consequences and ending weight

nodes.label: 5-Room Structure
nodes.description: theGreatGM five-room dungeon/encounter structure used throughout sessions; entrance, puzzle, setback, climax, reward/revelation

nodes.label: Dawnborn Reaction Tracker
nodes.description: GM tool tracking each Dawnborn's trust/consent state across sessions; feeds into which endings are achievable

edges.note: Both GM tracking tools feed into campaign ending determination; reaction tracker is input, moral scorecard is output metric
Crisis escalation scale determines which ending is reachable; faction actions shift the state space
